subject: Operations
title: The Suez Canal Blockage
description: A fast breakdown of The Suez Canal Blockage for builders.

hook.text: One ship stuck in a canal blocked $9.6 billion in trade per day for six days. One failure point froze global trade.

buildup.text: In March 2021, the Ever Given ran aground in the Suez Canal—a chokepoint handling 12% of global trade.

discovery.text: High winds and human error caused the grounding. The real failure was supply chain concentration through one canal.

twist.text: Over 400 ships queued on both sides. Ripple effects lasted months—container shortages, congestion, delayed deliveries.

climax.text: The incident exposed how fragile global trade is when it depends on a few geographic chokepoints.

punchline.text: One stuck ship showed the world how fragile global trade is.

quiz.question: What percentage of global trade passes through the Suez Canal?
